models.name: shopping_system_configurations
models.description: Platform-wide key/value configuration entries for system-level settings (URL, SMTP, feature flags, etc). These are needed for initialization, seeding, and global runtime parameterization. Each config is uniquely keyed and soft deletable for historical reference.

plainFields.name: config_key
plainFields.description: Unique system configuration key (case-insensitive, e.g. 'core.smtp_server').

plainFields.name: config_value
plainFields.description: Configuration value, serialized as text (JSON or plain values).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Documentation of what this config controls.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Configuration creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Configuration last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Configuration deletion timestamp (soft delete).

models.name: shopping_business_settings
models.description: Global business policy and operational settings for the shopping platform: currency, supported regions, tax policy, regulatory flags, etc. Used for deployment-wide logic, onboarding, and migration. Only one row per setting type/key is permitted. No coupling to business actors.

plainFields.name: setting_key
plainFields.description: Business setting key (e.g., 'currency', 'country', 'tax_region').

plainFields.name: setting_value
plainFields.description: Arbitrary string data for the setting value (could serialize as JSON for compound).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Description of this setting.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Row creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Row last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Row deletion time (soft delete).

models.name: shopping_status_enums
models.description: Centralized status code/enum definitions for use across the platform (orders, reviews, payments, etc). Enables reference-integrity, decouples code from hardcoded enums, and allows runtime editing of business states. Soft deletable for historical tracking.

plainFields.name: enum_domain
plainFields.description: Domain/entity scope for this status enum (such as 'order', 'review', 'payment').

plainFields.name: status_code
plainFields.description: Exact status code (e.g., 'pending', 'paid', 'failed', case-insensitive).

plainFields.name: display_label
plainFields.description: Human-readable label to display for this status in UIs.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description: Ordering value for deterministic sequence in dropdowns or reports.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this status code is currently in active use (business logic toggle).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Comment or description for this enum value.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time when the enum was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this row was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for enum deprecation.

models.name: shopping_category_trees
models.description: Root node definition for each independent category tree or taxonomy used by the platform (e.g., shop main categories, secondary/auxiliary trees for brands, etc). Not tied to actors or transactions. Implements unique category tree code per taxonomy.

plainFields.name: tree_code
plainFields.description: Unique category tree code for this taxonomy (case-insensitive, e.g., 'main', 'brand')

plainFields.name: tree_name
plainFields.description: English/official display name for this category tree.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Business context for the category tree usage/role.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Tree creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Tree update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp.

models.name: shopping_categories
models.description: One row per category node in any registered category tree. Supports multi-level hierarchical structure via optional parent relationship. Used only for classification and system-level grouping – never directly coupled to transactions or business actors. Category code and tree ID must be unique per tree.

plainFields.name: category_code
plainFields.description: Unique code for this category node, lowercase, unique per tree (e.g. 'womens_dresses').

plainFields.name: category_name
plainFields.description: Display name for this category node.

plainFields.name: sort_order
plainFields.description: Order among siblings for deterministic tree display.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional category notes or usage documentation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Category creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Category update time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Category deletion (soft delete).

models.name: shopping_system_logs
models.description: System-wide append-only audit or operational logs. Used for tracking system events, errors, administrative actions, migrations, or audit trails. Not tied to user/business actor context. Full-text search enabled for efficient diagnostics.

plainFields.name: event_time
plainFields.description: Timestamp for when the log event was generated.

plainFields.name: log_level
plainFields.description: Severity or log level (e.g., 'info', 'warn', 'error', 'fatal').

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Type/category of log event (e.g., 'system_init', 'migration', 'admin_action').

plainFields.name: event_source
plainFields.description: Origin/source of the event (module, subsystem, service name).

plainFields.name: message
plainFields.description: Summary log message.

plainFields.name: details
plainFields.description: Optional event details, stack trace, or contextual metadata (potentially JSON-encoded).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Log row creation time (for durability trace).

models.name: shopping_customers
models.description: Registered customer accounts. Each customer has unique authentication credentials, personal contact details, address book (via shopping_customer_addresses), and is the principal actor for placing consumer orders, writing reviews, and managing shopping carts. Sessions are managed by shopping_customer_sessions.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer email for login, uniquely identifies the account. Used for authentication and transactional notification.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Password hash (never plain). Used for secure login verification per industry standards.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Full display name of the customer for delivery and personalization.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Primary contact phone for verification and delivery notifications.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Indicates if the customer account is active and allowed to log in.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft-deletion of the account. Used for GDPR/business retention.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp at which the customer account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for last account data update.

models.name: shopping_customer_sessions
models.description: Sessions for logged in customers. Each session records authentication, connection metadata, audit, and supports multiple concurrent logins per customer. Linked to customer via shopping_customers.id.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address where the session originated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL on which login or session was established.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referring page or context for session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for session creation/login event.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session ended or was revoked (nullable for open sessions).

models.name: shopping_customer_addresses
models.description: Address book for customers. Contains shipping and billing addresses per customer. Each address explicitly belongs to one customer only.

plainFields.name: address_line1
plainFields.description: First address line (street, apartment no, etc.)

plainFields.name: address_line2
plainFields.description: Second address line (optional details such as suite, etc).

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City or locality for address.

plainFields.name: state
plainFields.description: State, province or administrative district.

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal or ZIP code for the address.

plainFields.name: country
plainFields.description: Country name (e.g. South Korea, United States, etc.)

plainFields.name: is_primary
plainFields.description: Marks if this is the primary/default address for customer.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Contact phone number for recipient at this address.

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Recipient's display name for delivery purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Address record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for the address entry.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for address records, for compliance/audit.

models.name: shopping_sellers
models.description: Registered merchant accounts. Each seller has unique business credentials, authentication, profile, and is the principal actor managing products, fulfillment, and inventory. Sessions are managed via shopping_seller_sessions. Business data is stored in shopping_seller_business_infos. Seller addresses managed via shopping_seller_addresses.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Seller email for login, notifications, and business verification. Uniquely identifies seller in authentication flows.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Password hash for seller account authentication.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Public-facing business/shop name of the seller.

plainFields.name: contact_phone
plainFields.description: Primary business contact phone for seller.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Seller account status (pending, active, suspended, rejected). Used for onboarding/compliance.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for account soft-deletion (retain for legal and audit).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Stamp for seller account creation and onboarding.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for seller profile.

models.name: shopping_seller_sessions
models.description: Authentication/audit sessions for sellers. Tracks session-specific context for business/operational security, and supports concurrent device logins. Each session belongs to one seller only.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Originating IP address of the logged-in session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL or endpoint at session start.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: HTTP referrer at login/session init.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session instantiation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: When session ended/revoked. Nullable for currently open sessions.

models.name: shopping_seller_business_infos
models.description: Legal and business registration/compliance details for sellers. Stores documentation, registration numbers, tax info, and all admin proof-of-KYC for compliance. Strictly 1:1 per seller.

foreignFields.name: shopping_seller_id
foreignFields.description: One-to-one relation: the associated seller's {@link shopping_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: legal_entity_name
plainFields.description: Registered legal entity/business name for tax, KYC, and compliance.

plainFields.name: registration_number
plainFields.description: Business registration/tax number required for platform compliance.

plainFields.name: representative_name
plainFields.description: Official representative's name for legal contacts.

plainFields.name: support_contact
plainFields.description: Customer support phone/email for merchant business.

plainFields.name: bank_account_number
plainFields.description: Primary bank account for settlement/payment payouts to seller business.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for legal/business info submission or most recent update.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for last update of business information.

models.name: shopping_seller_addresses
models.description: Address book for sellers. Stores origin, business, and return addresses, delivery endpoints and branch pickup points. Each address attached to exactly one seller.

plainFields.name: address_line1
plainFields.description: Primary address string (building/street).

plainFields.name: address_line2
plainFields.description: Detail address (suite/floor, etc).

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City/locality.

plainFields.name: state
plainFields.description: Administrative region/province/state.

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: ZIP/postal code for this address.

plainFields.name: country
plainFields.description: Country name field.

plainFields.name: is_return_address
plainFields.description: True if this entry is for goods returns/refunds (not a shipping origin).

plainFields.name: is_primary
plainFields.description: Indicates if this is the primary/main address for the shop.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Local business/contact phone for branch/pickup site.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Address entry creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp of address detail.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-deletion timestamp for address entry, audit/compliance.

models.name: shopping_admins
models.description: Platform administrator accounts. Have system-level permissions to manage users, sellers, escalations and platform settings. MFA and immutable audit logging apply. Not authorized for purchasing/selling.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique admin email for login and notifications.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Password hash for authentication.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Admin real name, used for audit and communications.

plainFields.name: role
plainFields.description: Admin privilege level (super, support, etc). Used for RBAC policy enforcement.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Admin account business status (active, suspended, pending, etc).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, for audit/compliance. Cannot be physically deleted while system active.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Account creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp for admin record.

models.name: shopping_admin_sessions
models.description: Record of authentication sessions for admin actors. Used for session security, audit, and two-factor tracking. Each session belongs to one admin.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Login IP address for event.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL on which admin authentication took place.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referring or source URL for session start.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Login/session start timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for session end/logout. Nullable if open session.

models.name: shopping_user_emails
models.description: Stores secondary, unverified, or historical emails for users (both customers and sellers), supporting contact updates, verification flows, and audit/history. A user can have multiple entries but only one primary login email (stored on customers/sellers table).

foreignFields.name: shopping_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Linked customer's {@link shopping_customers.id} if customer email.

foreignFields.name: shopping_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Linked seller's {@link shopping_sellers.id} if seller email.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Secondary, pending, or historical email address.

plainFields.name: is_verified
plainFields.description: Indicates if this email address has been verified by user action.

plainFields.name: is_primary
plainFields.description: Indicates if this is current primary email for user (must sync to associated customer/seller table).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this email entry was created/added.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Most recent update to this email record.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp (removed from account but retained for audit).

models.name: shopping_password_resets
models.description: Verification and tracking for password reset requests. Supports secure reset links, session tokens, expiration, and audit traceability for customers, sellers, and admins. Associated via at least one FK to actor table. Reset tokens and security details handled at the application service level, not stored here.

foreignFields.name: shopping_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Password reset request linked to customer (nullable for seller/admin usage).

foreignFields.name: shopping_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Password reset request linked to seller (nullable for customer/admin usage).

foreignFields.name: shopping_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Password reset request linked to admin (nullable for customer/seller usage).

plainFields.name: request_email
plainFields.description: Email used to request password reset, used for lookup and audit.

plainFields.name: reset_code
plainFields.description: One-time reset code/token (never plaintext in schema—used for service token lookup/audit/expiration only).

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for the reset code (typically 1 hour).

plainFields.name: consumed_at
plainFields.description: If reset code has been used/invalidated, timestamp of consumption event.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Request creation timestamp for trace and audit.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Most recent update to reset request record (for auditing changes, e.g., cancelation).

models.name: shopping_products
models.description: Core catalog products available in the shopping mall platform. Each product contains general product information (name, description, price, main image, etc.) and is associated with a seller (FK to shopping_sellers), categories, tags, and SKUs. Supports both published (active) and draft/archived status, provides audit and soft delete fields. Subject to category and tag assignments via subsidiary tables.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique business code for the product, used for lookup or external referencing.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Product display name shown to shoppers. Used for search and catalog display.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Long description of the product for customer information and search indexing.

plainFields.name: main_image_uri
plainFields.description: URI to the primary display image associated with this product.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Product status (e.g., draft, active, archived, under_review). Used in workflow.

plainFields.name: business_status
plainFields.description: Business workflow status (e.g., in_review, approved, rejected).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for auditing.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last updated timestamp for auditing.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-deleted timestamp. If not null, product is archived/not shown to shoppers.

models.name: shopping_product_snapshots
models.description: Historical snapshots of full product state for audit trail and change history. Captures all product fields and foreign key references as they were at the time of the snapshot. Used to reconstruct prior states, enable moderation, or restore historical product versions. All edits to shopping_products generate a snapshot entry.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Business code at time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Name at time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Long description at time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: main_image_uri
plainFields.description: Primary image at time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Product status at time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: business_status
plainFields.description: Business workflow status at time of snapshot.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Snapshot creation timestamp.

models.name: shopping_product_images
models.description: Images associated with products for catalog display. Each image is linked to a product and stores a URI reference. Allows multiple images per product (up to 10 per business rules).

plainFields.name: image_uri
plainFields.description: URI pointing to an image file (JPEG/PNG, up to 5MB per upload).

plainFields.name: order_index
plainFields.description: Zero-based display order for product images.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Upload/creation timestamp.

models.name: shopping_skus
models.description: Individual sellable SKU entities under a product. Each SKU represents a unique combination of attribute values (variant), price, and inventory reference. Linked to parent product, and optionally to inventory and category. Carries pricing, in-stock state, and audit fields.

plainFields.name: sku_code
plainFields.description: Unique SKU business code (externally visible, globally unique).

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Retail price for this SKU variant.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: SKU enabled/disabled state. If false, not purchasable.

plainFields.name: barcode
plainFields.description: Optional barcode/UPC for scanning.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Business process status (e.g., in_stock, discontinued, archived).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Updated timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-deleted timestamp (if set, SKU is archived).

models.name: shopping_sku_variants
models.description: Junction table mapping each SKU to its set of selected variant attribute values. Supports up to 5 attribute variants per SKU (e.g., color, size, material). M:N between SKU and attribute value, allowing rich filtering and search.

plainFields.name: order_index
plainFields.description: Order of this attribute among the variants for the SKU.

models.name: shopping_sku_images
models.description: Images assigned directly to a SKU (variant). Used to represent visual attributes of a SKU (e.g., color swatch).

plainFields.name: image_uri
plainFields.description: URI of the SKU-specific image asset.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Upload timestamp.

models.name: shopping_attribute_dimensions
models.description: Defines the possible attribute types used for product/SKU variants (e.g., Color, Size, Material). Managed by admins/sellers for flexible product setup. Each dimension may apply to many products and values.

plainFields.name: dimension_code
plainFields.description: Business code for this attribute dimension (used for filtering, must be unique).

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Display name of the attribute dimension (e.g., Color, Size).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Long description for this attribute dimension's purpose.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

models.name: shopping_attribute_values
models.description: Possible selectable values for each attribute dimension (e.g., Red, Blue for Color). Each value is connected to its dimension and may be shared among products. Enables SKU variant composition.

plainFields.name: value_code
plainFields.description: Unique code for this attribute value (used in filtering, must be unique within the dimension).

plainFields.name: display_value
plainFields.description: Display string (e.g., "Red", "Large", "Cotton").

plainFields.name: display_order
plainFields.description: Sort order for this value among siblings.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

models.name: shopping_product_attributes
models.description: Junction table marking which attribute dimensions and values apply to a given product (not variant-specific). Used to expose filtering and faceted search features in the product catalog. M:N between shopping_products and attribute values.

models.name: shopping_category_product_assignments
models.description: Junction table assigning products to one or more categories. Many-to-many mapping between products and shopping_categories. Used for catalog display and filtering. Only leaf categories are valid assignments.

foreignFields.name: shopping_category_id
foreignFields.description: Category's {@link shopping_categories.id}. Only leaf nodes allowed.

models.name: shopping_product_tags
models.description: Defines tags that can be applied to products for filtering and search enhancement. Each tag is a free-form label managed by sellers or admins. Tags can be assigned to multiple products through the tag assignment table.

plainFields.name: tag_code
plainFields.description: Business code/slug for the tag (must be unique).

plainFields.name: display_value
plainFields.description: Displayed tag name (e.g., "Eco-Friendly").

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Description/purpose of this tag.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

models.name: shopping_product_tag_assignments
models.description: Junction table connecting products and tags (M:N). Enables sellers to attach multiple tags to any product for catalog search and filter operations.

models.name: shopping_inventory
models.description: Represents the authoritative, real-time inventory state for each SKU. This is the sole source of current stock count and status per SKU. Adjustments are never made directly; all changes are append-only logged and then reflected here. Soft delete used for SKU discontinuation/audit retention. Foreign key to the SKU entity, all other SKU/product information is referenced, never stored/duplicated.

foreignFields.name: shopping_sku_id
foreignFields.description: SKU entity this inventory record tracks. {@link shopping_skus.id}. One-to-one with inventory record.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Current available units. Must be >= 0. Stock-outs (0) and re-stocks update this value atomically.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When inventory record was created. Used for auditing.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When inventory last changed. Updated only via atomic adjustment flow.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion/audit retention: populated if SKU is removed/discontinued, not physically deleted for compliance.

models.name: shopping_inventory_adjustments
models.description: Ledger-style append-only log for every adjustment event that alters inventory. Immutably captures before/after, delta, reason, actor context. Snapshots exact stock transitions for compliance, rollback, and detailed reporting. Does not soft-delete/never updated. Actor polymorphic fields store actor_id (uuid) and actor_type (string) for disambiguation between customers, sellers, admins. All IDs are simple UUIDs, never relations, to prevent coupling between audit and account systems.

foreignFields.name: shopping_inventory_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the inventory instance being changed. {@link shopping_inventory.id}.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Which actor class performed this adjustment (customer, seller, admin, or system). Polymorphic: not a relation.

plainFields.name: actor_id
plainFields.description: UUID of the involved actor (user/admin/seller/system). No foreign key: denormalized for immutable audit history.

plainFields.name: reason_code
plainFields.description: Reason code for adjustment (order, refund, manual, etc). Used for filtering and analytics.

plainFields.name: quantity_before
plainFields.description: Quantity before adjustment applied.

plainFields.name: quantity_after
plainFields.description: Quantity after adjustment.

plainFields.name: adjustment_amount
plainFields.description: Delta applied by adjustment: quantity_after = quantity_before + adjustment_amount.

plainFields.name: context_note
plainFields.description: Optional context/note (order/payment reference, administrator comment, batch ID, etc).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the adjustment event was logged. Creation timestamp only, never updated.

models.name: shopping_inventory_alerts
models.description: Inventory operational alerts: low-stock, stockout, anomaly triggers. Each alert is unique per SKU/condition. Alerts track if they are open (active) or resolved along with context of resolution. Actor info on resolution is polymorphic: actor_type string and actor_id UUID (no foreign keys, as alerts may be resolved by admins, sellers, or system events).

foreignFields.name: shopping_sku_id
foreignFields.description: The SKU for which the alert was generated. {@link shopping_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: alert_type
plainFields.description: Type of alert: low_stock, out_of_stock, anomaly, manual. Used for logic and filtering.

plainFields.name: resolved
plainFields.description: True if alert has been addressed and is no longer active, else false.

plainFields.name: triggered_at
plainFields.description: When alert was created (triggered).

plainFields.name: resolved_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp alert was resolved/closed, if applicable.

plainFields.name: resolved_actor_type
plainFields.description: Actor class that resolved the alert. Optional: 'admin', 'seller', 'system'.

plainFields.name: resolved_actor_id
plainFields.description: UUID of resolving actor (admin/seller/system). Optional. No FK.

plainFields.name: context_note
plainFields.description: Explanation or context on why alert was opened or resolved. Useful for operators.

models.name: shopping_carts
models.description: Shopping cart owned by a logged-in customer for storing items prior to order. Each customer has at most one active cart. Associates directly with the corresponding {@link shopping_customers} and is cleared upon successful order or account deletion. Supports persistence, merging guest carts (by session) at login. Main entry point for cart-related API operations.

foreignFields.name: shopping_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer's {@link shopping_customers.id}. References owner of the cart.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Cart creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Cart last updated timestamp (e.g., addition/removal of item).

models.name: shopping_cart_items
models.description: Items contained in a customer's cart. Strict junction between shopping_carts and shopping_skus, with unique constraint per sku. Stores the quantity, variant/sku context, and add/update timestamps for each item-in-cart. Enforces no duplicate SKUs per cart.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Item quantity for this SKU within the cart. Enforced maximum at application level (e.g., 10).

plainFields.name: added_at
plainFields.description: When this item was added to cart.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Latest update (quantity change) for the cart item.

models.name: shopping_guest_carts
models.description: Shopping cart for a guest (unauthenticated, session-based) user. Each guest cart is identified by a unique session key and optionally has an expiration. No customer or account FK present. Serves as the basis for merging into account cart upon login/registration. Deleted or expired per business policy.

plainFields.name: session_key
plainFields.description: Opaque unique session key for guest cart (e.g., UUID, random secret).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Cart creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Cart last update time for activity tracking.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: When this guest cart will expire and be deleted. Enforced by scheduled cleanup jobs.

models.name: shopping_guest_cart_items
models.description: Items in a guest cart. Junction table mapping a guest cart (session-based) to specific SKU selections and quantities. Unique per (cart, SKU). Deleted upon guest cart merge/expiration.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Quantity for this SKU in guest cart.

plainFields.name: added_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp item added.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Latest update timestamp.

models.name: shopping_wishlists
models.description: Wishlist owned by a logged-in customer. Each customer has at most one wishlist. Contains SKUs/products the customer is interested in; supports independent management apart from the cart. Main entry point for wishlist API operations.

foreignFields.name: shopping_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer's {@link shopping_customers.id}. Owner of the wishlist.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Wishlist creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Wishlist last update timestamp.

models.name: shopping_wishlist_items
models.description: SKUs contained in a customer's wishlist. Junction between wishlist and SKU, unique per (wishlist, SKU). Allows future addition of metadata (e.g., added date) and supports efficient lookup for customer recommendations.

plainFields.name: added_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp SKU was added to the wishlist.

models.name: shopping_orders
models.description: Core order entity representing a customer purchase transaction. References one customer and includes summary pricing and relationship to lines, splits, addresses, and payment attempts. Audit timestamps support full lifecycle traceability. Central to all business fulfillment and payment processes.

plainFields.name: order_code
plainFields.description: Globally unique, human-readable order reference code (e.g., ORD-20240001). Used in customer and business workflows.

plainFields.name: total_price
plainFields.description: Total price for the entire order (aggregated from lines).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current order status (see status history for changes). E.g. 'pending', 'paid', 'processing', 'fulfilled', etc.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Order creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Order last updated timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Order soft delete timestamp; null if active.

models.name: shopping_order_lines
models.description: Individual order line item, representing a single SKU and its quantity/fulfillment. Linked to both shopping_orders and shopping_skus. Basis for refunds, fulfillment, status, and review eligibility.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Ordered quantity of the SKU.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Final per-unit price for this SKU in the order (post-discount/tax).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current fulfillment status of this item (e.g., pending, shipped, delivered).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Order line creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Order line update time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete for this line; null if active.

models.name: shopping_order_splits
models.description: Represents split of an order, per seller, when a customer order contains items from multiple sellers. Each split is processed, fulfilled, and tracked independently.

plainFields.name: split_code
plainFields.description: Unique code for this split (order + seller). Used for tracking/reporting.

plainFields.name: subtotal_price
plainFields.description: Subtotal price for this seller in this order, sum of related order lines.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status for the seller's portion (e.g., 'pending', 'fulfilled').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Split creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Split last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete for this split; null if active.

models.name: shopping_order_status_histories
models.description: Audit log of order and split status changes over time. Captures transition events, who/what triggered them, previous/new status, timestamp, and optional notes. Used for business auditing and troubleshooting.

foreignFields.name: shopping_order_split_id
foreignFields.description: Order split's {@link shopping_order_splits.id}, if status applies to a split. Nullable.

plainFields.name: from_status
plainFields.description: Previous status value.

plainFields.name: to_status
plainFields.description: New status value for the transition.

plainFields.name: triggered_by
plainFields.description: Actor/role/automated source that initiated the transition.

plainFields.name: event_note
plainFields.description: Optional freeform note about the event/context.

plainFields.name: occurred_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of status transition.

models.name: shopping_payment_attempts
models.description: Tracks all attempts to pay for an order (including failures, retries, or alternate payment methods). Links to core order; each record includes results and unique payment gateway identifiers as appropriate.

foreignFields.name: shopping_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order this payment attempt is for: {@link shopping_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: payment_reference
plainFields.description: External provider or gateway reference for this payment attempt. May be empty until submitted to processor.

plainFields.name: attempt_status
plainFields.description: Status for this attempt (e.g., pending, completed, failed, cancelled).

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: Total amount attempted to charge.

plainFields.name: attempted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of payment attempt creation.

plainFields.name: completed_at
plainFields.description: When payment attempt finished (succeed/failed); null if still pending.

models.name: shopping_order_fulfillments
models.description: Actual fulfillment action for a given order line. Links to an order line with details such as fulfillment/shipping date, label, fulfillment address, and status. Multiple fulfillment records possible per line to support split-shipments or partial fill scenarios.

foreignFields.name: shopping_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller fulfilling this order line: {@link shopping_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: fulfillment_code
plainFields.description: Tracking code/label for fulfillment event. Human-readable, unique for this record.

plainFields.name: quantity_fulfilled
plainFields.description: Quantity filled in this fulfillment event.

plainFields.name: fulfilled_at
plainFields.description: When fulfillment (handoff to carrier) completed.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status (e.g. 'pending', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled').

plainFields.name: note
plainFields.description: Optional note for fulfillment details (instructions, etc).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Fulfillment record creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update time.

models.name: shopping_order_addresses
models.description: Stores delivery/billing address records associated to orders. Subsidiary record — not independently managed, but supports audit and business reporting in event of address changes. Kept for audit trail after order is completed.

foreignFields.name: shopping_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order associated with this address: {@link shopping_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Address type, e.g. 'shipping', 'billing' (noted for each record).

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Name of the delivery/billing recipient.

plainFields.name: recipient_phone
plainFields.description: Contact phone for recipient (formatted as per local standards).

plainFields.name: zip_code
plainFields.description: Postal or ZIP code, as required by destination.

plainFields.name: base_address
plainFields.description: Main street address (no apartment/extra details).

plainFields.name: detail_address
plainFields.description: Apartment, suite, or additional info (optional).

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City name/district for route assignments.

plainFields.name: state_province
plainFields.description: State, province, or region.

plainFields.name: country
plainFields.description: Country code (ISO 3166-1 or platform standard).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Address record creation time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Address record last update time.

models.name: shopping_refund_requests
models.description: Central entity for refund, return, or cancellation requests. Represents a standalone business process initiated by a customer or escalated by a seller/admin. Contains references to the original order and actor, request type, reason, context, and status. Attachments and request items are linked via subsidiary tables. Approval and override processes reference this model.

foreignFields.name: shopping_actor_id
foreignFields.description: ID of the actor initiating the request (customer/seller/admin). {@link shopping_customers.id}/{@link shopping_sellers.id}/{@link shopping_admins.id} depending on actor_type.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor initiating the request. Must be 'customer', 'seller', or 'admin'.

plainFields.name: request_type
plainFields.description: Business type of request: 'refund', 'return', or 'cancellation'.

plainFields.name: business_reason
plainFields.description: Short non-nullable business provided reason for the request. E.g. 'item defective', 'ordered by mistake', etc.

plainFields.name: request_context
plainFields.description: Optional additional structured context or metadata associated with the request (may contain JSON as string).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current business status of the request (e.g., 'pending', 'awaiting_approval', 'approved', 'declined', 'completed', 'escalated', etc).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the request was last modified (status changed, reason updated, etc).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Optional soft deletion of refund request for business/audit reasons.

models.name: shopping_refund_request_items
models.description: Links individual order line items to a refund request. Used to itemize which order lines/SKUs are subject to refund, return, or cancellation claims. Contains FK refs to parent request, order, and order line item, and tracks quantity and item-specific reason if set. Always a child of a refund request.

foreignFields.name: shopping_order_line_id
foreignFields.description: Specific order line (SKU) being refunded. {@link shopping_order_lines.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units in the order line requested for refund/return/cancellation (must be ≥1, ≤ order line quantity).

plainFields.name: item_business_reason
plainFields.description: Optional item-specific business reason for requesting refund. Overrides parent reason if set.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last modification to this item record.

models.name: shopping_refund_attachments
models.description: Stores any evidence, photos, documents, or files attached to a refund request or refund item. Each attachment always references a parent request and optionally a specific request item. Links to generic attachment files handled in global file storage. Always subsidiary to a refund request.

foreignFields.name: shopping_refund_request_item_id
foreignFields.description: Optional: refund request item this attachment is associated with. {@link shopping_refund_request_items.id}.

foreignFields.name: attachment_file_id
foreignFields.description: FK to attachment file entity (managed in the file storage subsystem). {@link shopping_product_images.id} or generic attachment.

plainFields.name: attachment_type
plainFields.description: Type of attachment (e.g., 'evidence', 'photo', 'invoice', etc).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable description of attachment purpose or content.

plainFields.name: uploaded_at
plainFields.description: Time attachment was uploaded.

models.name: shopping_refund_status_histories
models.description: Append-only snapshot/audit log of all status transitions, actor actions, and context for a refund request. Every change to a refund's status, escalation, approval, or override creates a new record. Supports full audit trails. Provides a read-only chronological timeline.

foreignFields.name: shopping_actor_id
foreignFields.description: ID of the actor making this status change. {@link shopping_customers.id}/{@link shopping_sellers.id}/{@link shopping_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor making the status change: customer, seller, admin.

plainFields.name: previous_status
plainFields.description: Request status before this transition.

plainFields.name: new_status
plainFields.description: Request status after the transition.

plainFields.name: timestamp
plainFields.description: When this status change occurred.

plainFields.name: change_context
plainFields.description: Optional additional context or comments for audit/reference.

models.name: shopping_refund_approvals
models.description: Record of approval or rejection actions for a given refund request. Includes compliance and workflow details; each approval is tied to the request and status history, and records actor and audit fields. Approval actions are explicitly recorded regardless of acceptance or rejection for traceability.

foreignFields.name: shopping_refund_status_history_id
foreignFields.description: Specific status change being approved/rejected. {@link shopping_refund_status_histories.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_actor_id
foreignFields.description: Actor performing the approval/rejection action. {@link shopping_admins.id}/{@link shopping_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor approving/rejecting (admin, seller).

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Approval action taken: 'approved', 'rejected', or relevant state.

plainFields.name: note
plainFields.description: Optional note or rationale for approval/rejection.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the approval/rejection is recorded.

models.name: shopping_refund_admin_overrides
models.description: Captures administrative override/escalation/forced-resolution actions by platform admin for refund cases. Used for compliance, legal, or regulatory interventions. References parent refund request, admin actor, context, and timestamps. Always subsidiary to a refund instance.

foreignFields.name: shopping_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin actor performing the override. {@link shopping_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: override_type
plainFields.description: Type of override (e.g., 'force_accept', 'force_reject', 'reassign', etc).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Business or legal reason for performing the override.

plainFields.name: detailed_context
plainFields.description: Optional detailed business/technical context or metadata for trace.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the override was initiated.

models.name: shopping_shipments
models.description: Represents a single logical shipment process which may fulfill part or all of a customer order. Contains courier allocation, main status, and summary delivery data. Each shipment aggregates multiple packages and references the originating order, allowing support for split shipments and multi-carrier fulfillment. Business context: managed by admin or warehouse ops; users/sellers view but do not edit. Relates to {@link shopping_shipment_packages}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Owning seller/business for this shipment. {@link shopping_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique shipment code for business/ops tracing (e.g. SHPT-2025-0001).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Shipment lifecycle status (e.g. pending, packed, in_transit, delivered, canceled, returned).

plainFields.name: carrier_company
plainFields.description: Allocated shipping/courier company (display name, e.g. FedEx, CJ대한통운).

plainFields.name: carrier_service_type
plainFields.description: Specific courier service used (e.g. overnight/express/standard, if multi-option).

plainFields.name: scheduled_dispatch_at
plainFields.description: Planned dispatch/shipping datetime for warehouse logistics (nullable for ad-hoc).

plainFields.name: dispatched_at
plainFields.description: Actual shipment dispatch timestamp (for logistics/audit trail).

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: Final shipment delivered/courier scan timestamp (null until completed).

plainFields.name: canceled_at
plainFields.description: If canceled, timestamp of shipment cancellation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Entity creation timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Entity last updated timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null unless deleted.

models.name: shopping_shipment_packages
models.description: Physical package unit within a shipment. Each shipment may contain 1..n packages, supporting split or consolidated packaging. Tracks package dimensions, weight, carrier label, and fulfillment details. Used for traceability, lost/damaged shipment handling, and external tracking number assignment. Relates to {@link shopping_shipments} via shipment_id and to {@link shopping_shipment_trackings}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_shipment_id
foreignFields.description: Parent shipment this package belongs to. {@link shopping_shipments.id}.

plainFields.name: sequence
plainFields.description: Sequence/order of the package within the parent shipment.

plainFields.name: package_label
plainFields.description: Carrier/warehouse-assigned package ID or label for internal ops.

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Courier-generated unique tracking number (external use).

plainFields.name: package_weight_grams
plainFields.description: Weight in grams for carrier, shipping cost, and customs.

plainFields.name: length_cm
plainFields.description: Length (cm) of package for shipper/courier specs.

plainFields.name: width_cm
plainFields.description: Width (cm) for fulfillment and shipper/courier specs.

plainFields.name: height_cm
plainFields.description: Height (cm) of package.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Package status (e.g. pending, ready, shipped, in_transit, delivered, lost, damaged).

plainFields.name: delivered_at
plainFields.description: If final, recorded delivery timestamp (external scan).

plainFields.name: lost_at
plainFields.description: If lost/undeliverable, recorded timestamp.

plainFields.name: damaged_at
plainFields.description: If carrier or warehouse logs as damaged during process, timestamp noted.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Entity creation timestamp (UTC).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update UTC timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp, null unless deleted.

models.name: shopping_shipment_trackings
models.description: Tracking instance for each package/courier. May exist for each shipment_package if more than one carrier or external tracking source is involved (e.g. handoff between domestic/international carriers). Used for reconciliation of multiple tracking sources and complete audit trace. Each is linked to a single package and may log API/scan info, last known status, and expected/estimated delivery. Not managed directly by end-users.

foreignFields.name: shopping_shipment_package_id
foreignFields.description: Parent package this tracking instance is associated with. {@link shopping_shipment_packages.id}.

plainFields.name: tracking_source
plainFields.description: Source of tracking data (e.g. courier_api, warehouse_scan, customer_report, manual); for logging provenance.

plainFields.name: external_tracking_id
plainFields.description: Unique tracking reference provided by external carrier/courier API (if available).

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Most recently reported status from this tracking instance (e.g. in_transit, delivered, delayed, exception, lost).

plainFields.name: status_detail
plainFields.description: Full text from latest tracking event/status message (raw message or system mapped).

plainFields.name: last_update_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update from carrier/API/scan or manual update.

plainFields.name: estimated_delivery_at
plainFields.description: Estimated delivery time, if provided by courier or computed by system.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Row created UTC timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification UTC timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp.

models.name: shopping_shipment_tracking_events
models.description: Immutable, append-only log of all significant tracking events for a shipment package. Each event corresponds to a single timestamped scan, status update, or tracker API callback—may include carrier codes, location, raw event text, and associated URLs or external references. Enables full audit trail and external integration troubleshooting. Managed as an event log, not for direct CRUD except system ingestion.

foreignFields.name: shopping_shipment_tracking_id
foreignFields.description: Linked tracking instance (which is, in turn, linked to a package). {@link shopping_shipment_trackings.id}.

plainFields.name: event_time
plainFields.description: Datetime of this tracking event (scan/callback/receipt/etc; not necessarily same as system ingested time).

plainFields.name: event_code
plainFields.description: Courier or platform event code (‘DELIVERED’, ‘IN_TRANSIT’, ‘OUT_FOR_DELIVERY’, etc), or custom code for system events.

plainFields.name: location
plainFields.description: Event location (city, warehouse, or geo string); null if not supplied by source.

plainFields.name: raw_status
plainFields.description: Raw status/description from external tracking event or API; full, unmapped text.

plainFields.name: external_ref
plainFields.description: URL or reference provided by external tracker system (tracking link, scan ID, etc).

plainFields.name: ingested_at
plainFields.description: UTC time when this event was ingested by the system (differs from event_time when delayed).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Row creation time (UTC).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete flag/timestamp; event log is never hard-deleted, but deletions are tracked for audit.

models.name: shopping_reviews
models.description: Main business entity representing a customer review for a specific SKU in an order. Each review is uniquely associated with a customer, a SKU, and an order line, ensuring eligibility rules are enforced. Review records contain rating, text, and status/state fields. Key relationships: links to customer, SKU, order line. Independent entity for full CRUD, moderation, and audit tracking.

foreignFields.name: shopping_order_line_id
foreignFields.description: Order line this review corresponds to (enforces eligibility). {@link shopping_order_lines.id}

plainFields.name: rating
plainFields.description: Star rating value (1–5, required for aggregation)

plainFields.name: comment
plainFields.description: User review comment (10–2000 characters, required).

plainFields.name: state
plainFields.description: Current review state (visible, pending_moderation, removed, under_review, etc.). Business workflow uses values such as: 'visible', 'pending', 'removed', 'under_review'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Review creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for most recent review modification.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker for removed reviews (nullable).

models.name: shopping_review_attachments
models.description: Supporting entity for storing file, image, or video attachments belonging to a single review. Attachment records reference reviews and store metadata about the uploaded content. Managed only within the review API context.

plainFields.name: file_uri
plainFields.description: Storage URI or URL for the attachment file.

plainFields.name: file_type
plainFields.description: Mime/media type of the attachment (e.g., image/png, video/mp4).

plainFields.name: file_size
plainFields.description: Attachment file size in bytes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Attachment creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker for the attachment (nullable).

models.name: shopping_review_moderations
models.description: Snapshot/audit trail entity recording all moderation or state transitions for reviews. Each record logs an action (e.g., approved, removed, restored), actor (admin), timestamp, and any rationale or comments. Enables full moderation traceability.

foreignFields.name: moderator_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin moderator who performed the action. {@link shopping_admins.id}

plainFields.name: action
plainFields.description: Type of moderation action (approved, removed, restored, flagged, edited, etc.).

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Moderator-provided reason or notes about the action taken.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp this moderation action was performed.

models.name: shopping_review_abuse_reports
models.description: Main entity for customer- or seller-initiated abuse reports against a review. Independently created entity that logs the actor, review, type of abuse, report comments, and audit timestamps. Enables report CRUD and workflow review by admins.

plainFields.name: report_type
plainFields.description: Type/category of abuse reported (e.g., spam, hate_speech, off_topic, etc.).

plainFields.name: comment
plainFields.description: Optional textual explanation or evidence for the report.

plainFields.name: state
plainFields.description: Abuse report state (open, processed, dismissed, etc.).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Report creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Most recent report modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete, null if active.

models.name: shopping_review_rating_aggregates
models.description: Materialized view table that stores denormalized pre-aggregated rating and review statistics for each SKU and its parent product. Optimizes product and SKU listing queries for average rating and review count. Not directly modifiable by users.

foreignFields.name: shopping_product_id
foreignFields.description: Parent product for the SKU (for aggregate at product level). {@link shopping_products.id}

plainFields.name: review_count
plainFields.description: Total number of reviews for this SKU.

plainFields.name: average_rating
plainFields.description: Average star rating for this SKU (precalculated, one decimal precision).

plainFields.name: product_review_count
plainFields.description: Total reviews for the parent product (aggregated from all SKUs).

plainFields.name: product_average_rating
plainFields.description: Average rating for the product overall (across SKUs).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Aggregation refresh timestamp for cache invalidation/business needs.

models.name: shopping_audit_logs
models.description: Contains immutable records of all critical business and security-sensitive operations performed on the platform. Each record represents an atomic, auditable event, such as admin/seller/customer actions, privilege escalations, or system overrides. Designed for compliance and traceability across the system. Linked to the actor performing the action when available. Used for regulatory reporting, security investigations, and dispute handling.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin actor performing the logged operation. {@link shopping_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller actor affected by this action if relevant. {@link shopping_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer actor affected by this action if relevant. {@link shopping_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: category
plainFields.description: Structured log category or domain (e.g., 'security', 'order', 'refund', 'inventory').

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Machine-readable code for the specific action (e.g., 'ADMIN_SUSPEND_SELLER', 'ORDER_MANUAL_REFUND', 'PRIV_ESCALATION').

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the operation originated, for traceability.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable summary of the event, for audit reports or investigation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp (immutable atomic event recording).

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp (immutable, but may indicate additional annotation).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker if the log was removed from default query views.

models.name: shopping_admin_action_logs
models.description: Contains records of major administrative operations—such as admin grants/revocations, privileged data edits, forced password resets, dispute decisions, and system policy changes. Linked to both the action author (admin) and, optionally, the affected actor. Used for internal auditing, role reviews, and compliance checks. Each log entry is immutable and fully auditable.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin actor who performed the action. {@link shopping_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: affected_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin account affected by this action, if relevant. {@link shopping_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Constant representing the action kind (e.g., 'GRANT_ROLE', 'FORCE_RESET', 'SUSPEND_SELLER').

plainFields.name: entity_type
plainFields.description: Type of entity affected (e.g., 'product', 'order', 'user', 'setting').

plainFields.name: entity_id
plainFields.description: ID of the affected entity (could be product, order, etc.), for linkable action context.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Optional business context or rationale for the admin's action.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Action record creation time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker; set if the log should be hidden from normal reports.

models.name: shopping_admin_suspensions
models.description: Records all suspensions imposed by platform admins upon other admins, sellers, or customers. Includes both temporary and permanent suspensions. Used for audit trails, business rule enforcement, and compliance reporting. References the admin who enacted the suspension, the affected entity, suspension reason, dates, type, and decision status.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who imposed the suspension. {@link shopping_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: suspension_type
plainFields.description: Type of suspension imposed (e.g., 'temporary', 'permanent', 'pending_appeal').

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Detailed business reason for suspension (policy violation, fraud, etc.).

plainFields.name: start_at
plainFields.description: Suspension effective start time.

plainFields.name: end_at
plainFields.description: End time for temporary suspensions; null if permanent.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status (e.g., 'active', 'expired', 'revoked', 'pending_appeal').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Suspension creation record timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp, for audit/log purposes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker; marks the record as hidden in default views.

models.name: shopping_platform_announcements
models.description: Stores all platform-wide announcements initiated by admins. Each record captures title, content, target audience, visibility windows, publication status, and author (admin reference). Used to push maintenance, update, and official notices to all or filtered user segments. Status and schedule fields control announcement display periods.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who authored the announcement. {@link shopping_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Announcement title, shown in notification headers and listings.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Full announcement content, potentially with markdown formatting.

plainFields.name: target_audience
plainFields.description: Audience segment/role to receive this announcement (e.g., 'all', 'customers', 'sellers', 'admins').

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current lifecycle status (e.g., 'draft', 'scheduled', 'active', 'expired', 'hidden').

plainFields.name: publish_start_at
plainFields.description: Optional scheduled start datetime for announcement display.

plainFields.name: publish_end_at
plainFields.description: Optional end datetime for announcement visibility.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when record last updated (may be for content changes).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for hiding from listings/reporting.

models.name: shopping_policy_violations
models.description: Tracks all detected or reported business policy violations involving any actor or entity (customer/seller/admin/product/order/etc). Each record references the violated policy, the reporting actor, affected entity, violation type/code, description, status, dates, and decision history. Used for compliance, after-action reviews, automation triggers, and escalation to appeals. Supports complex violation lifecycle.

foreignFields.name: policy_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to violated business policy configuration. {@link shopping_business_policies.id}.

foreignFields.name: reported_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who filed the violation report, if applicable. {@link shopping_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: reported_by_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who reported the violation, if any. {@link shopping_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: reported_by_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who reported the violation, if any. {@link shopping_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: affected_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin account affected by the violation (e.g., internal compliance cases). {@link shopping_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: affected_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller account affected by violation. {@link shopping_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: affected_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer account affected by violation. {@link shopping_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: violation_type
plainFields.description: Constant for violation class (e.g., 'abuse', 'fraud', 'duplicate_account', 'policy_breach').

plainFields.name: violation_code
plainFields.description: Machine-readable code for violation (from business policy reference).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-readable violation summary for admins/reviewers.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current lifecycle status (e.g., 'open', 'under_review', 'resolved', 'escalated', 'invalid', 'canceled').

plainFields.name: decision
plainFields.description: Resolution or adjudication result; null if not yet decided.

plainFields.name: decision_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the resolution decision.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time when violation record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp (typically investigation note/decision).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete for audit/cleanup, not for physical erasure.

models.name: shopping_appeals
models.description: Tracks formal appeals filed against suspensions, account actions, business policy violations, or other adverse admin/adminops actions. Records the target entity, appeal reason, status, decision, and reviewer admin. Supports audit trail, multi-stage decision, and escalations. Crucial for regulatory, compliance, and dispute-handling processes.

foreignFields.name: appeal_of_suspension_id
foreignFields.description: References the base suspension being appealed, if applicable. {@link shopping_admin_suspensions.id}.

foreignFields.name: appeal_of_policy_violation_id
foreignFields.description: References corresponding policy violation, if applicable. {@link shopping_policy_violations.id}.

foreignFields.name: filed_by_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller who filed the appeal, if externally. {@link shopping_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: filed_by_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who filed the appeal. {@link shopping_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: reviewed_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who reviewed or decided the appeal. {@link shopping_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Detailed business reason and supporting context for the appeal.

plainFields.name: status

plainFields.name: decision

plainFields.name: decision_at
plainFields.description: Datetime of appeal decision.

models.name: shopping_business_policies
models.description: Defines named business policies for platform-wide application or specific domains. Used to codify and audit enforceable business rules such as return windows, commission rates, and user eligibility thresholds. Referenced by other domains for outward enforcement; never contains operational data itself.

plainFields.name: policy_name
plainFields.description: Unique name for the business policy (e.g., 'order_return_window', 'seller_onboarding_requirement'). Used for outward reference and enforcement in other domains.

plainFields.name: scope
plainFields.description: Scope or domain where this policy applies (e.g., 'global', 'orders', 'sellers').

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Value or threshold for the policy (e.g., '30', 'approved'). Can be interpreted as string, integer, or enum as required by consuming domain.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the business purpose and operational impact of this policy.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Whether this policy is currently active and enforced platform-wide.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Policy creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Policy update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp, if the policy is archived or replaced. Null if active.

models.name: shopping_business_constraints
models.description: Defines system-wide or domain-specific constraints (e.g., rate limits, maximum SKU count, min/max purchase values). Used for enforcing quantitative limits or operational boundaries across the platform. Referenced by other domains by outward FK, never inward.

plainFields.name: constraint_name
plainFields.description: Unique name of the constraint (e.g., 'max_orders_per_user_day', 'sku_max_per_product'). Used for lookups and enforcement.

plainFields.name: scope
plainFields.description: Scope or domain for the constraint (e.g., 'global', 'carts', 'checkout', 'products').

plainFields.name: limit_value
plainFields.description: Constraint value, typically an integer or decimal encoded as string (actual enforcement handled in consuming domain).

plainFields.name: unit
plainFields.description: Unit for the constraint's value (e.g., 'count', 'seconds', 'amount').

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Full business explanation of what limit this constraint applies and its operational significance.

plainFields.name: active
plainFields.description: Whether the constraint is currently in force.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Constraint creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Constraint last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp; null if constraint is active.

models.name: shopping_feature_flags
models.description: Manages feature toggles and rollout switches for platform capabilities (e.g., beta features, A/B experiments, domain-scoped rollouts). Admins can independently enable/disable features or set percentage rollout. Outward referenced for controlled enablement, not bound to specific session or user here.

plainFields.name: flag_name
plainFields.description: Unique name of the feature flag (e.g., 'new_checkout_flow', 'wishlist_enabled'). Used for outward reference and API enablement.

plainFields.name: scope
plainFields.description: Domain or context where this feature applies (e.g., 'global', 'orders', 'checkout', 'frontend').

plainFields.name: enabled
plainFields.description: Indicates whether the feature is enabled system-wide for the associated scope.

plainFields.name: rollout
plainFields.description: (Optional) Percentage 0-100 for gradual rollout/experimentation. 100 = fully enabled, 0 = off (used for A/B testing).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Explanation of feature flag purpose and behavior under enabled/disabled conditions.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Feature flag creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Update timestamp for the feature flag.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp; null if flag is active.
